rule.title: Code T, a Roth IRA distribution, with a Roth contribution for 2020 or earlier: 4b is 0

citation.wording: You received a distribution from a Roth IRA. But if either (a) or (b) below applies, enter -0- on line 4b; you don't have to see Form 8606 or its instructions. a. Distribution code T is shown in box 7 of Form 1099-R and you made a contribution (including a conversion) to a Roth IRA for 2020 or an earlier year.

rule.open_point: Catalogued as prior-year, and it is not one: the year of the first Roth contribution is printed on no 2024 return (2024 Form 8606 line 22 is a basis, not a year), so it is asked. Case (b), code Q, is rule a-r-12.
